vb_textbox.text: I chose the most 'natural' coloured gnome - either green or brown. This seemed to have a good return to begin with. Half way through I changed things around and used the purple or red gnomes a little more - they seemed to return a good amount of mushrooms, but sometimes zero.I would recommend using the natural coloured ones most of the time - you get 2-5 mushrooms the majority of the time when you select them.
